descriptionByLocale.en: True to the vision "We drive innovation to improve people's lives", Hamilton companies have been providing solutions for the healthcare industry since 1950. We are an innovative pioneer in terms of ventilators, automated pipetting and storage of samples and the development of process sensors. The Operations business unit produces parts for all Hamilton companies from injection moulded parts to pipette tips for liquid handling to metal and plastic parts. Our goal is to produce as many parts as possible in-house. In this way, we remain agile, independent and efficient. You can do that : - Reliable and cost-optimal storage arrangement of the electronics product group - Order processing with the ERP system for new and existing articles - Checking the order confirmations - Delivery time securing / delivery time warning - Processing of error messages - Editing and implementing eForms (change notifications, article integrations) - Capture and monitor volume contracts - Maintaining the article master data in the ERP - Obtaining and evaluating offers in consultation with the Strategic Procurement Manager - Participation in optimization projects in procurement - Cooperation in supplier evaluation - Checking and approving supplier invoices - Compliance with processes, governance and compliance This is what you bring : - Basic electronic or electrical engineering training completed - Further education as a purchasing specialist or in supply chain management - Experience as an operational (r) buyer in the industrial environment - Reliable personality with entrepreneurial thinking - Independent, structured and conscientious working methods - Own initiative, negotiating skills and enforcement - Open, communicative and integrity person - Teamplayer - Very good ERP and Office skills - Negotiable in German and English, in word and writing Learn more about career opportunities at Hamilton at jobs.hamilton.ch.
